title: Update site branding to include “MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER”

requirements.text: Update the centralized site branding/content configuration so the phrase "MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER" appears as part of the business identity shown across the site (preferably via the existing tagline field), and ensure the header and footer display the updated branding wherever they render values from the centralized configuration.

quotes: add MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER

acceptanceCriteria: The phrase "MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER" is present in frontend/src/content/siteConfig.ts as part of the branding content (e.g., in tagline).
The site header shows the updated branding text on desktop and mobile views (including inside the mobile menu).
The site footer shows the updated branding text if it renders tagline/branding from the centralized configuration.

requirements.text: Update SEO defaults so the static HTML title and meta description include the updated branding ("IQRA COMMUNICATION" and "MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER") and do not conflict with the centralized branding message.

quotes: add MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER

acceptanceCriteria: frontend/index.html <title> includes "IQRA COMMUNICATION" and "MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER".
frontend/index.html meta description includes "MOBILE STORE AND REPAIRING CENTER".
No user-facing SEO text references an unrelated business type (e.g., "Professional Business Solutions") if it contradicts the new branding.

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only).
Do not modify immutable frontend hook/provider files listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT (compose existing hooks/components instead).
Keep all user-facing text in English.
nonGoals: Do not add new pages, routes, or navigation items unless explicitly requested.
Do not implement any new backend functionality; backend can remain unchanged.
